parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing support for the door, drawer, and base.
parts.Functional_description: It holds all other parts together and provides the main storage compartment structure.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and supports the weight of the cabinet and its contents.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel that covers the storage compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and can be opened or closed using a handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding wooden compartment located at the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a smaller storage space for utensils or small items and can be pulled out for access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails or runners.
